title: unified-rollouts: shadow traffic balancer + staging-window + multi-metric auto-rollback
author: Asha Mehta
description: Motivation: Improve safety and observability for progressive model rollouts by making shadow traffic configurable and introducing a staging window for metric stabilization. This PR adds a lightweight traffic balancer for shadow traffic, a configurable staging_window that delays metric decisions for canary/shadow phases, and extends the auto-rollback engine to evaluate multiple metrics (latency_p95, error_rate, model_accuracy_regression) using a weighted decision policy. Includes API and CRD changes, controller implementation, tests, and docs. Checklist: - [x] Controller implementation - [x] API/CRD changes and validation - [x] Multi-metric auto-rollback engine - [x] Integration and e2e tests (flaky test retried once) - [x] Docs and examples - [x] Backwards-compatible defaulting (no breaking change) Related: ENG-5421 design doc, ENG-5603 postmortem follow-up, SUP-1287 customer incident reproducibility.

review_comments: Diego Morales: Please ensure the staging_window default is conservative (30m) and document how it affects billing. Asha Mehta: Default set to 30m and added doc note about cost implications.

Claire Zhou: The multi-metric evaluator looks good but we should expose metric weights at policy-level and set safe defaults. Asha Mehta: Exposed weights as policy.weights and added validation in rollout.proto.

Noah Rivera: e2e test failed once on CI (flaky) — reran and passed. Consider retry logic for monitoring tests. Asha Mehta: Added single-retry wrapper for flaky e2e tests and a TODO to revisit in flaky-tests epic.
Diego Morales: Small nit: prefer explicit circuit-breaker backoff when shadow backend returns 429. Asha Mehta: Added exponential backoff and metrics for 429-rate to shadow_balancer.
release_notes: Adds configurable shadow traffic balancer and staging_window to unified rollouts. Extends auto-rollback to evaluate multiple metrics with weighted decision policies. Backwards-compatible defaults applied; no breaking changes expected. See docs/unified-rollouts.md for migration steps and example rollout-staging.yaml.
notes_for_ops: Operator notes: new CRD fields (staging_window, shadow_policy, metric_weights) default to safe values. Helm chart updated to expose default staging_window (30m) and shadow sampling rate. Recommend monitoring rollout.metrics.{latency_p95,error_rate,accuracy_regression} and configuring alerts for combined rollback_score > threshold.
testing_summary: Local unit tests and integration harness run. Added two new integration tests covering shadow balancing and staging window behavior. CI showed one flaky e2e test which was retried and passed. Load bench confirms no regression up to 2x baseline RPS with staging_window enabled.
documentation_changes: Updated redwood-docs/docs/unified-rollouts.md with staging_window section, shadow_policy examples, and recommended metric weight presets. Added example in examples/rollout-staging.yaml and migration script scripts/migrate-rollout-crds.sh.
